# All Measures {#all-measures}

Every variable in the SONA REDCap project, organized by measure in the order participants saw them. Click a measure to see its description, scoring notes, and full variable table. Use the search bar to find a variable name, item wording, or measure, and the **Show** buttons to narrow tables to survey items or to REDCap-calculated (scored) variables.

```{r all-measures, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================
# LIBRARIES
# ==============================
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(htmltools)
library(commonmark)

# ==============================
# LOAD DATA
# Codebook/sona_codebook.xlsx is generated from the REDCap PDF codebook
# (Redcap_Raw_Codebook/Sona-codebook.pdf) by scripts/parse_redcap_pdf.py and
# scripts/build_codebook.py. One row per REDCap field.
# ==============================
sona <- read_xlsx("Codebook/sona_codebook.xlsx") |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "", as.character(.x))),
         Order = as.integer(Order))

# ==============================
# CLEANING FUNCTIONS
# Same conventions as the Embark Lab Meta Codebook, so SONA measures line up
# with the other projects' measure names if SONA is added there later.
# ==============================
format_measure <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_to_upper()
}

sona <- sona |>
  mutate(Measure = format_measure(Measure))

# ==============================
# MEASURE DESCRIPTIONS
# Each measure has its own .md file in Codebook/descriptions/.
# Filename = lowercased measure name with non-alphanumerics replaced by "_".
# To add/edit a description, just create/edit that file — no R changes needed.
# ==============================
descriptions_dir <- "Codebook/descriptions"

measure_to_filename <- function(measure_name) {
  key <- format_measure(measure_name)
  key <- tolower(key)
  key <- str_replace_all(key, "[^a-z0-9]+", "_")
  key <- str_replace_all(key, "^_+|_+$", "")
  file.path(descriptions_dir, paste0(key, ".md"))
}

get_description <- function(measure_name) {
  path <- measure_to_filename(measure_name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(sprintf(
      "<em style='color:#888;'>No description yet. Create <code>%s</code> to add one.</em>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(path)
    ))
  }
  md <- paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
  commonmark::markdown_html(md)
}

# ==============================
# VARIABLE TYPE (used for the Show filter and row colours)
# ==============================
sona <- sona |>
  mutate(VarKind = case_when(
    `Field Type` == "calc"                                   ~ "scored",
    `Field Type` == "descriptive" | str_ends(Variable, "_complete") ~ "admin",
    TRUE                                                     ~ "item"
  ))

# Measures in survey order (order of first appearance in REDCap)
measure_list <- sona |>
  group_by(Measure) |>
  summarise(first = min(Order), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(first) |>
  pull(Measure)

missing_descriptions <- measure_list[
  !file.exists(vapply(measure_list, measure_to_filename, character(1)))
]
if (length(missing_descriptions) > 0) {
  message("Measures still missing description files:\n  - ",
          paste(missing_descriptions, collapse = "\n  - "))
}

# ==============================
# CSS
# ==============================
css <- HTML("
<style>
  .measure-description {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    border-left: 3px solid #bf5700;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #343a40;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .measure-description p              { margin: 0 0 8px 0; }
  .measure-description p:last-child   { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .measure-description ul,
  .measure-description ol             { margin: 4px 0 8px 20px; padding: 0; }
  .measure-description li             { margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .measure-description code {
    background: #e9ecef; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
    font-size: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  }
  .measure-description blockquote {
    border-left: 3px solid #e8590c; background: #fff4e6;
    margin: 6px 0; padding: 6px 10px; color: #5c3d00;
  }
  .measure-description a              { color: #1971c2; text-decoration: underline; }

  .search-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #search-input {
    flex: 1; max-width: 360px; padding: 6px 10px;
    border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px;
  }
  #search-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #bf5700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(191,87,0,0.2); }
  .clear-search-btn {
    border: none; background: #868e96; color: white;
    padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
  }

  .var-filter-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; align-items: center; }
  .var-filter-btn {
    border: none; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px;
    cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.4; transition: all 0.18s ease-in-out; color: white;
  }
  .var-filter-btn.active { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.06); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
  .var-filter-btn.all-vars   { background-color: #868e96; }
  .var-filter-btn.items-btn  { background-color: #1971c2; }
  .var-filter-btn.scored-btn { background-color: #2f9e44; }
  .expand-btn {
    border: 1px solid #ced4da; background: white; color: #495057;
    padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 8px;
  }

  .legend { font-size: 11px; color: #555; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .legend span { display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: middle; }
  .leg-item   { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ccc; }
  .leg-scored { background-color: #e8f5e9; }
  .leg-admin  { background-color: #f1f3f5; }
  tr.scored td { background-color: #e8f5e9; }
  tr.admin  td { background-color: #f1f3f5; color: #666; }

  details.measure-block { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  details.measure-block > summary {
    padding: 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 8px; user-select: none;
  }
  details.measure-block > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  details.measure-block > summary::before { content: '\\25B8'; color: #888; margin-right: 2px; }
  details.measure-block[open] > summary::before { content: '\\25BE'; }
  details.measure-block[open] > summary { border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
  .measure-count { font-size: 11px; color: #888; margin-left: 4px; }
  .form-tag {
    font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    background: #e9ecef; color: #495057; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 8px;
  }
  .details-content { padding: 12px; }

  table.dict-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }

  }

  table.dict-table td.var { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
  table.dict-table td.type { font-size: 11px; color: #666; white-space: nowrap; }
  table.dict-table td.val { font-size: 12px; max-width: 420px; word-break: break-word; }
  .sec-head { font-size: 11px; color: #888; font-style: italic; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; }
</style>
")

# ==============================
# FILTER CONTROLS + JS
# ==============================
filter_controls <- HTML("
<div class='search-bar'>
  <strong style='font-size:13px;'>Search:</strong>
  <input type='text' id='search-input' placeholder='Search variable name, label, or measure...' oninput='applyFilters()'>
  <button class='clear-search-btn' onclick='clearSearch()'>Clear</button>
</div>

<div class='var-filter-bar'>
  <strong style='margin-right:4px; font-size:13px;'>Show:</strong>
  <button id='vbtn-all'    class='var-filter-btn all-vars active' onclick='filterVar(\"ALL\")'>All Variables</button>
  <button id='vbtn-items'  class='var-filter-btn items-btn'       onclick='filterVar(\"ITEMS\")'>Survey Items</button>
  <button id='vbtn-scored' class='var-filter-btn scored-btn'      onclick='filterVar(\"SCORED\")'>Scored (calculated) Variables</button>
  <button class='expand-btn' onclick='setAllOpen(true)'>Expand all</button>
  <button class='expand-btn' onclick='setAllOpen(false)'>Collapse all</button>
</div>

<div class='legend'>
  Row colours &nbsp;
  <span class='leg-item'></span> Survey item &nbsp;
  <span class='leg-scored'></span> Calculated in REDCap &nbsp;
  <span class='leg-admin'></span> Instructions / form status
</div>

<script>
var activeVar = 'ALL';

function clearSearch() {
  document.getElementById('search-input').value = '';
  applyFilters();
}

function setAllOpen(open) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.measure-block').forEach(function(b) {
    if (open) { b.setAttribute('open', ''); } else { b.removeAttribute('open'); }
  });
}

function filterVar(level) {
  activeVar = level;
  document.querySelectorAll('.var-filter-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
  var vmap = { 'ALL': 'vbtn-all', 'ITEMS': 'vbtn-items', 'SCORED': 'vbtn-scored' };
  document.getElementById(vmap[level]).classList.add('active');
  applyFilters();
}

function applyFilters() {
  var searchTerm = (document.getElementById('search-input').value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  document.querySelectorAll('.measure-block').forEach(function(block) {
    var measureName = (block.getAttribute('data-measure-name') || '').toLowerCase();
    var formName    = (block.getAttribute('data-form') || '').toLowerCase();
    var measureNameMatches = searchTerm === '' ||
                             measureName.indexOf(searchTerm) !== -1 ||
                             formName.indexOf(searchTerm) !== -1;
    var visibleCount = 0;

    block.querySelectorAll('tr[data-kind]').forEach(function(row) {
      var kind = row.getAttribute('data-kind');
      var rowVarOk = activeVar === 'ALL' ||
                     (activeVar === 'ITEMS'  && kind === 'item') ||
                     (activeVar === 'SCORED' && kind === 'scored');

      var rowSearchOk = true;
      if (searchTerm !== '' && !measureNameMatches) {
        var cells = row.querySelectorAll('td');
        var variableText = (cells[0] ? cells[0].textContent : '').toLowerCase();
        var labelText    = (cells[1] ? cells[1].textContent : '').toLowerCase();
        rowSearchOk = variableText.indexOf(searchTerm) !== -1 ||
                      labelText.indexOf(searchTerm) !== -1;
      }

      var show = rowVarOk && rowSearchOk;
      row.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      if (show) visibleCount++;
    });

    block.style.display = visibleCount > 0 ? '' : 'none';
    if (searchTerm !== '' && visibleCount > 0) { block.setAttribute('open', ''); }
  });
}
</script>
")

# ==============================
# BUILD MEASURE SECTIONS
# ==============================
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))

measure_sections <- lapply(measure_list, function(measure_name) {

  vars  <- sona %>% filter(Measure == measure_name) %>% arrange(Order)
  forms <- unique(vars$Form)

  n_items  <- sum(vars$VarKind == "item")
  n_scored <- sum(vars$VarKind == "scored")
  count_label <- sprintf(
    "<span class='measure-count'>(%d variables%s)</span>",
    nrow(vars),
    if (n_scored > 0) sprintf(" &middot; %d scored", n_scored) else ""
  )
  form_tags <- paste(sprintf("<span class='form-tag'>%s</span>", esc(forms)), collapse = " ")

  rows_html <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(vars)), function(i) {
    r <- vars[i, ]
    label_cell <- paste0(
      if (nzchar(r$`Section Header`))
        sprintf("<span class='sec-head'>%s</span>", esc(str_trunc(r$`Section Header`, 220))) else "",
      esc(r$Label),
      if (nzchar(r$`Branching Logic (Show field only if...)`))
        sprintf("<br><span class='sec-head'>Shown if: %s</span>",
                esc(r$`Branching Logic (Show field only if...)`)) else ""
    )
    type_cell <- paste0(
      esc(r$`Field Type`),
      if (nzchar(r$`Text Validation Type OR Show Slider Number`))
        sprintf(" (%s)", esc(r$`Text Validation Type OR Show Slider Number`)) else ""
    )
    sprintf(
      "<tr class='%s' data-kind='%s'><td class='var'>%s</td><td>%s</td><td class='val'>%s</td><td class='type'>%s</td></tr>",
      r$VarKind, r$VarKind, esc(r$Variable), label_cell,
      str_replace_all(esc(r$Value), " \\| ", "<br>"),
      type_cell
    )
  }, character(1))

  tbl_html <- sprintf(
    "<div style='overflow-x:auto;'>
       <table class='dict-table'>
         <thead><tr><th>Variable</th><th>Label</th><th>Value / Calculation</th><th>Type</th></tr></thead>
         <tbody>%s</tbody>
       </table>
     </div>",
    paste(rows_html, collapse = "\n")
  )

  desc_html <- sprintf("<div class='measure-description'>%s</div>", get_description(measure_name))

  tags$details(
    class               = "measure-block",
    `data-measure-name` = measure_name,
    `data-form`         = paste(forms, collapse = " "),
    tags$summary(HTML(paste0(
      "<strong>", esc(measure_name), "</strong> ", form_tags, " ", count_label
    ))),
    tags$div(class = "details-content", HTML(paste0(desc_html, tbl_html)))
  )
})

# ==============================
# FINAL OUTPUT
# ==============================
tagList(css, filter_controls, tagList(measure_sections))
```
